sloka: याश्चान्याः सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपाः सरांसि च ।प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहा स्समाहिताः ॥२-१५-६॥
transliteration: yāścānyāḥ saritaḥ puṇyā hradāḥ kūpāḥ sarāṁsi ca ।prāgvāhāścordhvavāhāśca tiryagvāhā ssamāhitāḥ ॥2-15-6॥

translations.english: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.
